subject.title: [Feature]: Allow agents to resolve Slack channel IDs to names via channel-info/channel-list

question: Should Slack agents receive both per-ID channel metadata and workspace-wide visible-channel enumeration, and should both use the existing channelInfo action gate?
rationale: Per-ID resolution is narrow, while channel-list expands agent-visible workspace metadata; the linked candidates also disagree on whether a new channelList config surface is warranted.

options.title: Approve both under channelInfo
options.body: Expose channel-info and bounded paginated channel-list in the Slack plugin under the existing gate, avoiding another config option.

options.title: Approve channel-info only
options.body: Provide ID-to-name resolution for known targets while withholding broad workspace enumeration.

options.title: Require separate list opt-in
options.body: Expose both actions but add a distinct channelList gate despite the repository's high bar for new configuration.

recommendation.title: Approve both under channelInfo
recommendation.body: Expose channel-info and bounded paginated channel-list in the Slack plugin under the existing gate, avoiding another config option.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent history across Slack action policy, runtime wiring, tests, documentation, and the broader parity proposal.
